address: Strucht 77, Schin op Geul, 6305 AH, Netherlands
bio: That fact that Ralf Berendsen is a perfectionist shows in every plate that reaches your table, in cooking executed with split-second precision and in the subtlest layers of flavour. The experienced chef elevates familiar flavours with delicate nuances and judicious touches of international seasoning. His cooking is complex yet never convoluted. The sauces are an experience in themselves. Take the pan-fried red mullet, topped with a quenelle of fine caviar, with a wonderfully intense coconut and red curry bisque providing the perfect accompaniment, alongside a sphere of raw gambero rosso and a sweet pepper cream. The chef's signature dishes, available both as part of a set menu and à la carte, fully deserve their reputation. A meal at this elegant restaurant leaves no doubt about Ralf Berendsen's exceptional craftsmanship.
